title: Rocky Road Festival, Mornington Peninsula Chocolaterie
summary: 31 limited-edition rocky road flavours across May at the Flinders chocolaterie. Free to wander, with ticketed hosted Sunday tasting sessions. Vegan, gluten-free and no-added-sugar options.
venueName: Mornington Peninsula Chocolaterie and Ice Creamery
priceRange: Free general entry; ticketed tasting sessions
accessibilityNotes: Accessible venue; indoor showroom and outdoor gardens
nearbyAttractions: Flinders Village; Cape Schanck; Red Hill wineries
suggestedItineraryPairing: Chocolate tasting + Cape Schanck coastal walk
editorVerdict: 31 flavours of rocky road for the price of a coffee, plus the chocolaterie is genuinely good. Easiest May weekend with kids on the Peninsula.
editorNote:
Every May the Mornington Peninsula Chocolaterie at Flinders runs 31 limited-edition rocky road flavours across the month. Wandering is free, the ticketed Sunday tasting session is the hosted version where you sit down and taste through a curated flight. Vegan, gluten-free and no-added-sugar options on the bench, which is rare for chocolate events at this scale.

Go Sunday morning, do the tasting session, then walk Flinders village and along to the pier before driving the coast road to Cape Schanck. With kids it's the easiest play of the month: indoor showroom, outdoor garden, ice cream window.

Book the Sunday tasting a fortnight ahead, the slots go.
